text: I can explain offsets, consumer groups and retention, and how a Kafka consumer replays from a timestamp.
I can size a Kafka topic's partitions and retention storage from throughput, record size and replication factor.
I can choose between direct, topic, fanout and headers exchanges and write topic-exchange binding patterns with * and #.
I can choose between SQS standard and FIFO and set a message group id that keeps per-entity order without serialising the queue.
I can justify Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS for a design from its needs for replay, routing, ordering and operations.
